header.title: How to Defrost an Upright Freezer
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to safely and effectively defrost an upright freezer. It covers preparation, the defrosting process, and cleanup to minimize mess and ensure proper freezer function.

steps.description: Prepare the upright freezer by unplugging it, emptying its contents into a cooler with ice packs, and removing shelves and baskets.
actions: Unplug the upright freezer
Empty the contents of the freezer
Place items in a cooler with ice packs
Remove shelves
Remove baskets
Remove small storage compartments

steps.description: Prepare the freezer bottom by placing towels and cookie sheets to catch melting ice and prevent refreezing.
actions: Take a towel.
Place the towel at the bottom of the freezer.
Place an aluminum cookie sheet on top of the towel.
Add more cookie sheets if they fit side by side.

steps.description: A garbage bag is used to catch water leakage during freezer defrosting by taping it to the freezer door and inside.
actions: Fan the garbage bag out so it does not cling to itself.
Place one side barely inside the freezer.
Tape the bag down inside the freezer.
Pull the bag open.
Tape the bag to the door so that the bag remains open and hanging from the freezer.

steps.description: Remove frost from the inside of the freezer using a plastic spatula and dispose of the ice.
actions: Scrape frost from the inside of the freezer with a plastic spatula.
Let the frost fall to the cookie sheet.
Dispose of the ice in the sink.
Catch any drips with the towel.
Remove the cookie sheets, towel, and bag.
Wipe down the freezer.
Replace everything.
